tenancy.title: SaaS Multi-Tenancy Infrastructure Tiers
tenancy.subtitle: Each pricing tier is physically matched with a dedicated data isolation strategy to guarantee SOC 2 and GDPR compliance.
tenancy.poolDesc: Shared database and shared schema. Isolated logically using PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS). High performance at lower overhead.
tenancy.bridgeDesc: Shared database with isolated schemas per tenant (`schema_{slug}`). Best of both worlds, avoiding connection pool exhaust.
tenancy.siloDesc: Physically separated database instance (`nota_tenant_{slug}`). High security, dedicated backups, custom domain, and isolated memory.
